title: betula alba var. bircalensis
intro: Betula alba var. bircalensis, commonly known as White Birch, is a deciduous tree native to the mountainous regions of Turkey and Iran. The health benefits of White Birch include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of White Birch include its use in traditional medicine to treat conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. Bioactive constituents of White Birch include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to have antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
